guard: on a user-auth mesh `cotal attach` opens the seat's session through the identity plane and never redeems from a local seed, and the identity plane refuses a session it cannot verify (#2312)
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && COTAL_USER_ENDPOINT_CLI_ONLY=1 pnpm smoke:user-spawn:live
why: The fixture drives the real bin/cotal.ts attach against a native user-auth broker, auth service and manager, with the space's static seed on disk (the fixture saves it for the pre-flip manager). The CLI resolves its built dist, so the command rebuilds the CLI first and afterRestore rebuilds it again.
The auth service the fixture starts imports @cotal-ai/auth from its dist, so the auth build runs before the suite and again after each restore.

mutations.name: the CLI falls back to the seed on a user mesh
mutations.replace:
case "user":
      return t.spaceAuth ? { kind: "mint", auth: t.spaceAuth } : { kind: "fatal", message: attachNoSeedMessage(t) };
mutations.expectRed: #2312: `cotal attach` on a user-auth mesh opens the seat's session
mutations.cell: #2312: `cotal attach` on a user-auth mesh opens the seat's session

mutations.name: the identity plane skips verification
mutations.replace:
const row = await readRow(r, claim.sessionId);
  return { endpoint: row.endpoint, sessionId: row.sessionId, epoch: row.serving.epoch, exp: Math.floor(row.exp / 1000) };
mutations.expectRed: #2312: a grant held by another owner is refused at the exchange (401)
mutations.cell: #2312: a grant held by another owner is refused at the exchange (401)

mutations.name: the expiry check is removed
mutations.find: if (row.exp <= now) deny(`session ${claim.sessionId} expired at ${new Date(row.exp).toISOString()}`);
mutations.expectRed: #2312: an expired session is refused at the exchange (401, the reason names the expiry)
mutations.cell: #2312: an expired session is refused at the exchange (401, the reason names the expiry)

mutations.name: the epoch check is removed
mutations.find: if (row.serving.epoch !== claim.epoch) deny(`session ${claim.sessionId} is pinned to serving epoch ${row.serving.epoch}, not ${claim.epoch}`);
mutations.expectRed: #2312: a wrong-epoch session claim is refused at the callout
mutations.cell: #2312: a wrong-epoch session claim is refused at the callout
